extracted text: The paper discusses 7075 aluminum alloy in the T6 condition that was subjected to Friction Stir Processing (FSP). The micro-hardness profile shows a value of 124 Hv in the center of the processed zone, with a maximum of 141 Hv at a distance of 3.5 mm from the center. The FSP process resulted in a fine, equiaxed grain structure with mean grain equivalent diameter close to 4 μm in the nugget zone.

abbreviations:
